key_exclusions: must cancel and rebook (in-place fare adjustment not allowed)
policy_text_full: Delta's 24-hour risk-free cancellation lets customers cancel and rebook at a lower fare within 24 hours of original booking. Refund is issued to original tender upon cancellation. The adjustment must be done via cancel-and-rebook — in-place fare changes are not supported.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 24 hours of booking, customers can cancel and rebook at a lower fare; the adjustment must be done via cancel-and-rebook, not in-place change.
